loss.normcap: DMC MSE + detach(alpha) state-mean variance(q - teacher_target)

specification.singletons: included in state denominator; zero centered term
specification.batch_policy: same shuffled DMC observations; one Adam step per batch
specification.compute_matching: environment hands only; no equality of updates, labels, trajectories or time
specification.common_reset: only P3f teacher-200 model; reset Adam and Python/CPU/CUDA RNG
